messages:
alex_sales: Quick sync — ACME wants an EU+APAC POC with strict residency. They need assurance that inference never leaves region for production tenants, but are okay with US for dev. Can we confirm routing + subprocessors and a rough delta for dedicated EU capacity?

josh_eng: We can pin tenant traffic to region via geofence + tenant routing. For strict residency we'd recommend Dedicated EU with region pinning. Need to confirm subproc list for EU GCP regions.

emily_security: @alex_sales please add their security questionnaire to the thread. Two flagged Qs: BYOK support (KMS only in EU), and subprocessor disclosure for audit.

alex_sales: dropping the questionnaire PDF here: https://acme.example.com/sec-q3.pdf — they highlighted BYOK, egress encryption, and list of subprocessors.

priya_platform: For routing, config looks like: \n```\n{\n  "tenant_id": "acme-poc",\n  "region_pin": "europe-west1",\n  "failover_policy": "apac->eu->us-dev-only",\n  "kms_scope": "customer-byo-kms-eu"\n}\n```\nThis will keep inference and KV cache in the pinned region.

sam_ops: Ops checklist: 1) Confirm subproc reachable endpoints 2) Provide cert chain for private peering 3) Validate KMS key policies (we support CMEK via our KMS connector).

rachel_pricing: Rough numbers: Dedicated EU pool (m) + pinning add ~25% uplift on top of base Dedicated. BYOK integration one-time engineering effort — estimate 8-12 engineer-hours, billing as professional services unless bundled.

emily_security: For subprocessors: we can provide a redacted list for presales; full list requires NDA/LOA. Also we support HSM-backed KMS if legal insists.

josh_eng: Technical note: if they need absolute no-egress we should recommend Private (VPC) deployment. Hosted Dedicated still has control plane signaling out-of-region for some control plane ops (we can sign an attestation).

alex_sales: Customer asked about fallback: if EU capacity saturated, can we failover to APAC without moving data to US?

priya_platform: Yes, we can set region fallback to APAC only. That avoids US. Need capacity pre-commit for APAC burst.

sam_ops: @rachel_pricing add APAC burst reserve pricing — also flag certificate thumbprints for their network team.

rachel_pricing: Added note — APAC burst +15% on top of EU dedicated uplift. I'll send a quick quote by EOD.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: POC tenant template created: acme-poc-519876. Next step: infra owner to approve keys and peering.

emily_security: Action items: alex to share signed NDA for full subproc list; I will prepare BYOK integration security notes.

alex_sales: Will request NDA from ACME and reply here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
